Domains
-------

_Domains organize the application's main navigation menu. Each domain groups the objects, processes, and external pages accessible to users from it. Domains can be nested: a domain may have a parent domain._

* `FtDomain`
  * `FtAttributes` _(object)_
  * `FtListItem` _(object)_
  * `FtCustomUser` _(object)_
  * `FtStates` _(object)_
  * `FtRelationshipO2m` _(object)_
  * `FtRelationshipM2m` _(object)_
  * `FtM2mChild` _(object)_
  * `FtReflexiveMany` _(object)_
  * `FtTaggedObject` _(object)_
  * `FtTag` _(object)_
  * `FtSelectObject` _(object)_
  * `FtTestMermaid` _(external)_
  * `FtNotification` _(object)_
  * `FtActions` _(object)_
  * `FtPublications` _(object)_
  * `FtSearch` _(object)_
  * `FtListOrdering` _(object)_
  * `FtGuidedObject` _(object)_
  * `FtHistory` _(object)_
* `FtDomainInline` _(sub-domain of `FtDomain`)_
  * `FtObjInlineParent` _(object)_
  * `FtObjInlineChild` _(object)_

### Fields

| Name                                                         | Type                                     | Column                         | Required | Updatable | Personal | Description                                                                      |

| **`usr_scope_id`** link to **`Scope`**                       | id                                       | usr_scope_id                   |          | yes       |          | -                                                                                |
| _`viw_name`_                                                 | _char(100)_                              | _viw_name_                     |          |           |          | _-_                                                                              |
| _`sco_name`_                                                 | _char(100)_                              | _sco_name_                     |          |           |          | _-_                                                                              |
| _`sco_home_id`_                                              | _id_                                     | _sco_home_id_                  |          |           |          | _-_                                                                              |
| _`viw_name`_                                                 | _char(100)_                              | _viw_name_                     |          |           |          | _-_                                                                              |
| _`mdl_name`_                                                 | _regexp(100)_                            | _mdl_name_                     |          |           |          | _-_                                                                              |
| `usr_image_id`                                               | image                                    | usr_image_id                   |          | yes       | yes      | -                                                                                |
| `usr_login`                                                  | regexp(100)                              | usr_login                      | yes*     | yes       | yes      | -                                                                                |
| `usr_first_name`                                             | char(50)                                 | usr_first_name                 |          | yes       | yes      | -                                                                                |
| `usr_last_name`                                              | char(50)                                 | usr_last_name                  |          | yes       | yes      | -                                                                                |
| `usr_lang`                                                   | enum(3) using LANG list                  | usr_lang                       | yes      | yes       | yes      | -                                                                                |
| `usr_email`                                                  | email(100)                               | usr_email                      |          | yes       | yes      | -                                                                                |
| `usr_cell_num`                                               | phone(20)                                | usr_cell_num                   |          | yes       | yes      | -                                                                                |
| `usr_active`                                                 | enum(1) using USER_STATUS list           | usr_active                     |          | yes       |          | -                                                                                |
| `ftUsrType`                                                  | enum(10) using FTUSRTYPE list            | ft_usr_type                    | yes      | yes       |          | -                                                                                |

### Enumerations

* `LANG`
    - `ENU` English language
    - `FRA` French language
* `USER_STATUS`
    - `0` Disabled
    - `1` Enabled
    - `2` Pending
    - `3` Web services only
* `FTUSRTYPE`
    - `FT_ADMIN` SimFeatures Admin
    - `FT_READ` SimFeatures Reader

### State transitions (`usr_active`)

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    state "Disabled" as 0
    state "Enabled" as 1
    state "Pending" as 2
    state "Web services only" as 3
    0 --> 1
    0 --> 2
    0 --> 3
    1 --> 0
    1 --> 3
    2 --> 0
    2 --> 1
    3 --> 0
    3 --> 1
```

`FtStates` (States) business object definition
----------------------------------------------

_No description._

**Physical table**: `ft_states`

### Relationships

* Has many **FtStatesHistoric** via `row_ref_id` [on delete: cascade, visible]

### Fields

| Name                                                         | Type                                     | Column                         | Required | Updatable | Personal | Description                                                                      |
|--------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------|--------------------------------|----------|-----------|----------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| `ftStOrder`                                                  | int(11)                                  | ft_st_order                    | yes      | yes       |          | -                                                                                |
| `ftStCode`                                                   | char(100)                                | ft_st_code                     | yes*     |           |          | -                                                                                |
| `ftStState`                                                  | enum(10) using FT_ST_STATE list          | ft_st_state                    | yes      | yes       |          | -                                                                                |

### Enumerations

* `FT_ST_STATE`
    - `INITIAL` Initial State
    - `A` State A
    - `OPTIONAL` Optional State
    - `B` State B
    - `EXCEPTION` Exceptional State
    - `FINAL` Final State

### State transitions (`ftStState`)

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    state "Initial State" as INITIAL
    state "State A" as A
    state "Optional State" as OPTIONAL
    state "State B" as B
    state "Exceptional State" as EXCEPTION
    state "Final State" as FINAL
    INITIAL --> A
    A --> OPTIONAL
    A --> B
    OPTIONAL --> A
    OPTIONAL --> B
    B --> EXCEPTION
    B --> FINAL
    EXCEPTION --> B
    FINAL --> [*]
```
